channel.title: The Signal — RSS demo fixture
channel.description: Fictional stories for demonstrating an RSS adapter offline.

item.title: A coastal grid learns to run on the wind
item.description: Engineers in a North Atlantic port are testing how offshore turbines and community batteries can keep the lights on when the weather changes.

item.title: Listening for glaciers before they break
item.description: Small acoustic sensors are helping field teams study how freshwater moves beneath the ice and how cracks spread through a glacier.

item.title: Small firms give empty storefronts a second life
item.description: Shared leases let a bakery, a bicycle repair shop and a bookbinder test new neighborhoods before committing to permanent space.

item.title: A public archive brings street recordings back to the city
item.description: Archivists digitized decades of interviews and street sounds, then asked residents to identify the places and people in them.

item.title: Night trains add room for bikes on a cross-border route
item.description: A seasonal timetable gives overnight travelers more space for bicycles and a longer window to change trains at the border.
